title: Frozen finite synthetic scenario and uncertainty baseline
authorization: Synthetic simulation and engineering verification; not true-state/history restoration or new coefficient identification
label: Source-calibrated effective baseline with SYNTHETIC_ASSUMED states and conditions

input.raw_role: Hash integrity only; no numeric refit or replay in this round
input.source: Chen et al., LG M50, original record https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4032561, CC BY 4.0; original units A,V,s,Ah,degC
input.old_validation: 6/8 pass, two low-current cutoff failures, aggregate scientific FAIL; cells03/04 old8 are known regression only

scenario_design.generator: numpy.random.Generator(PCG64); independently choose one entry per axis, in JSON axis order, 64 complete rows; no resampling invalid or duplicate rows
scenario_design.controls: Two named references, then each non-baseline value of every axis varied individually about memory_reference; no best-case selection
scenario_design.freeze: Write scenarios.json and its SHA256 before any physics solve, then commit protocol/scenarios locally
scenario_design.old_reference: anchor_z=1,p_fast=p_slow=0,gap=0,I_gap=0,R_slow=0,delta_U=0,C/H original,Ta=T0=26.8degC; fixed rest7200s leaves equilibrium unchanged

assumption_sources.charge_anchors: Illustrative priors; usable measured discharge capacity is not identified inventory capacity; eta=1 is a synthetic hypothesis
assumption_sources.gap_duration: 0 and conditional 2640..2760s wall-display arithmetic from R4; template is pre-run gap plus rest, NOT the actual SBr chronology or true missing history
assumption_sources.gap_current: Illustrative +/-0.05A unobserved input; NOT inferred leakage or charge efficiency
assumption_sources.initial_polarization: Illustrative +/-0.08V fast (old7.5A R1 loss scale) and +/-0.4V slow (observed relaxation scale, NOT an identified slow-state amplitude)
assumption_sources.slow_branch: Illustrative positive RC prior, no identified R/tau or claim of predictive improvement; adding RC to an effective U may double-count loss
assumption_sources.potential_stress: U_syn(z)=linear_interp(old9U,z)+delta*(1-z); -0.075V tests the old ~70mV endpoint deficit, +0.4V tests relaxation-scale model-form uncertainty; no optimized knots or true OCV claim
assumption_sources.thermal: C/H variations are engineering priors within original fit bounds; ambient/initial values use observed temperature scales only; not missing-temperature reconstruction
assumption_sources.probability: Discrete seeded design is not a probability distribution or empirical confidence interval

physics.charge: dz/dt=-I/(3600Q), current positive on discharge and negative on charge; propagate through gap/rest/profile without reset or clipping
physics.polarization: dp_k/dt=(I R_k-p_k)/tau_k; C_k=tau_k/R_k; branch disabled at R_slow=0 requires p_slow=0 and is omitted
physics.heat: qdot=I^2 R0+sum(p_k^2/R_k); nonnegative resistor dissipation, not I*sum(p) heat; reversible/entropic heat set0 by declared synthetic simplification
physics.temperature: C_th*dT/dt=qdot-H*(T-Ta); constant ambient in each entire scenario; exact exponential convolution, limit handled at equal poles
physics.initial_energy_prior: At the anchor only, E_RC<=0.1*3600Q*4.25J. This arbitrary engineering prior is not a conservation law, measured bound or all-time cap
physics.potential_constraints: 13 fixed knots [0,.001,.002,.005,.01,.025,.05,.1,.2,.4,.6,.8,1] interpolate old9 plus declared stress; no free coefficients; values2.3..4.25V and adjacent increments>=.001V
physics.state_constraints: z in[0,1] at all times, R/tau/C/H positive, finite Kelvin>0; invalids are retained; never restore/reset measured state
physics.voltage_upper_guard: V<=4.25V continuously over gap/rest/profile, partitioning every potential knot and stationary point; guard is a model prior, not a certified battery safety rating
physics.temperature_limit: No arbitrary thermal cutoff. Flag sampled T>55degC as extrapolation beyond prior source scale; no temperature validation law or credible range established

execution.history: Synthetic gap at prescribed I for prescribed duration, then7200s zero-current rest, then prescribed CC; per-scenario global anchor is explicit
execution.stop: First actual V<=2.5V, or z=0 model-domain end, or upper-voltage/model-validity guard; domain end without2.5V is NOT a physical cutoff or flight endurance
execution.cutoff_algorithm: On each linear-U interval V'=constant+two exponentials; isolate its roots by partitioning at the at-most-one derivative extremum. Split V at all stationary points and knots, then search the first threshold. No assumption of globally monotone V
execution.trace_note: Include exact stop, knots and voltage extrema; temperature maximum remains sampled at5s, not a certified continuous maximum
execution.budget: One CPU, IDLE priority, threads1,$0,each batch<=1800s; exclusive fpv lease; defer/pause own child for Lean/Lake, normal other priority work jobs retain priority
execution.runs: One primary manifest solve; rerun only after an actual code defect or failed frozen check, preserving original log/results and reasoning

verification.methods: Frozen analytic model vs independent SciPy solve_ivp oracle on predeclared cases; old zero-memory equivalence; conserved signed charge, RC passive energy and heat; zero-R branch; equal thermal poles; first crossing of a deliberately nonmonotonic voltage; seed/invalid preservation; all old tracked files hash invariant
verification.oracle_cases: old_reference plus memory_reference, anchor.95/negative input history and nonzero positive initial polarizations at current2.5A; no oracle parameter selection
verification.negative_controls: invalid charge overflow, initial energy-prior violation, forbidden nonzero disabled-branch state, upper-voltage prior violation, z=0 above2.5V, first-crossing/rebound trap; intentional invalids must stay rejected
verification.empirical_acceptance: NONE; no newly unseen measurement set or measured uncertainty coverage; old6/8 and aggregateFAIL retained
verification.fitting: Zero optimizer calls and zero coefficient updates

deliverables: Opt-in synthetic model/CLI, all frozen scenario inputs and statuses, full cell V/T traces and stop reasons, finite-design ranges/sensitivity, numerical checks, independent review, hashes/raw logs, local separate science/HTTP commits
exclusions: No new source downloads/search calibration, motor/ESC/prop/thrust identification, flight endurance claim, GUI/science conflation, gate relaxation, remote publish, merge or deployment
